verdict.rationale: Paxos documents issuing API credentials (client ID and secret) with configurable allowed scopes that restrict access to specific API endpoints (paxos-docs-2). These are used through OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication (paxos-docs-48, paxos-docs-34), which is a least-privilege, machine-to-machine credential model suited to an agent. Missing for 10: detailed scope catalog and granularity docs, credential rotation/revocation/expiry details, agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
